Ravi: Noticing a repeatable tail spike on shared-shelf-usw2-4 during tenant bursts. 95p up ~160ms. Window: 2026-03-25 19:07 UTC. :thinking:
Yuki: Any obvious metric? nvlink, pcie, or NIC?
Ravi: NVLink peer-to-peer + DMA counters high. Also tenant kvcache miss rate elevated for t-fjord and t-gale. Pattern: lots of parallel small requests (seq <= 32).
Anya: If it's P2P NVLink chatter we should avoid cross-rack migration. Two options: (A) short soft-throttle, (B) ephemeral carveout with reserved NVLink headroom.
Sanjay: Soft-throttle first. Can we try tagging and applying a temporary egress policer to confirm causality?
Ravi: I applied tag `nvlink_probe=true` and a 30s policer in staging; tail dropped back to baseline. No client errors in canary.
Ravi: Command used:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/tenants/t-fjord/labels \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"labels":{"nvlink_probe":"true"}}'

curl -X POST https://ops.internal/tenants/t-fjord/policer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"egress_tps":120,"burst":240,"duration_s":30}'
```
Yuki: Nice. We need an automated detector that ties nvlink_util + tenant_kvcache_miss to tagging + soft-shape. False positives are a concern (warmup storms).
Anya: Add ramp logic: require sustained > 2m OR 2 hits within 12m before enforcement. Dry-run in prod for 48h before auto-enact.
Sanjay: Also add audit metadata: reason=`nvlink_kv_churn`, trigger_ts, and action_id. CS/legal will want traces.
Ravi: Agreed. I created a quick Prom rule for dry-run:
```
- alert: NVLinkKVChurn
  expr: avg_over_time(nvlink_util{rack="usw2-4"}[2m]) > 0.82 and avg_over_time(tenant_kvcache_miss_rate[2m]) > 0.55
  for: 90s
  labels: { severity: warning }
  annotations: { summary: "Potential NVLink KV churn" }
```
Yuki: Run that in dry-run mode for 48h and collect hits. If real offenders show up, plan ephemeral carveout + prewarm.
Anya: Cost estimate for ephemeral 8xA100 prewarm ~ $580/day (ballpark). Finance to confirm. Suggest offering a 7-day trial credit for customers we move.
Sanjay: For routing fallback: we can route affected tenant traffic to `model-lite` variant which uses less inter-GPU KV traffic. Need runtime rule: if tenant_label=nvlink_probe -> prefer model=lite.
Ravi: I'll add the routing spec. Also we should instrument rollback frequency metric so we don't oscillate tags.
Ops-bot: Incident INC-20260325-09 created and paged oncall. Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/nvlink-churn
Yuki: Action items:
- Ravi: run 48h dry-run of prom rule (ETA: now)
- Sanjay: PR to noise-detector: labeling hooks + soft-shape executor + ramp logic (ETA: EOD)
- Anya: draft CS note + finance ask for carveout pricing (ETA: tomorrow)
- Yuki: routing fallback spec for model-lite (ETA: 48h)
Ravi: If dry-run shows >4 FP/day we tighten thresholds. If sustained tenant offenders found, we'll schedule ephemeral carveout and notify teams.
Anya: Also keep a manual override for CS so we don't throttle paying customers without approval.
Sanjay: I'll ensure audit logs include the override actor.
Ravi: Thanks. Will post dry-run results in #eng-infra in 48h. :memo:
